series.description:
Represents the series to be plotted in the chart.
Each series is a mapping of data to a plot, with configurations for how to display the data.

plots.description: The plots to be displayed in the chart. Allows the splitting of the chart into multiple plots.

title: Determines how a {@link UiApTimeseriesChart} should render its data.
name: UiApTimeseriesChartRenderConfig
